title: AI product company: training to agents in production

organisation.name: Cobaltine Labs
organisation.industry: AI software: document assistant for enterprises
organisation.size: 260 staff; ML research, platform and applied teams
organisation.summary: Cobaltine Labs sells an AI document assistant to enterprises. Customer apps call an inference API that runs an agent with three tools: retrieval over each customer's uploaded documents, a code-execution sandbox and a web browsing tool; some features call a third-party model provider. Conversation logs flow into a training data lake that feeds a feature store and a GPU training cluster. Trained models are registered, pass an evaluation pipeline and are deployed to the inference API by ML CI/CD.

ai_llm_security.summary: A web page the browsing tool fetches tells the agent to run code that sends data out
A crafted question makes the agent retrieve another tenant's passages

data_security.summary: Conversation logs with customer content become training data despite opt-outs
Uploaded documents are retrievable by any tenant through the agent

devsecops_supply_chain.summary: Any training job can register a model, and nothing proves where a promoted model came from
The evaluation gate checks models, not the prompt and tool changes ML CI/CD ships

container_kubernetes.summary: Every ML engineer can run privileged pods on the GPU cluster
Code sandboxes share nodes with the agent and reach the node metadata service

cloud_security.summary: The sandbox reaches the metadata service and the serving node role
The training jobs' role reads the whole data lake and writes the registry

api_security.summary: API keys are checked, but the tenant id in the request body is trusted for retrieval
Unbounded tool loops let one key drive thousands of model calls

application_security.summary: The browsing tool fetches internal addresses, including the metadata service
A crafted PDF exploits the document parser in the indexing job

grc_risk.summary: Contracts promise customer content is not used for training, but logs feed the data lake
Some features send customer documents to a third-party model provider

threat_intelligence.summary: Reports of attackers seeding web pages with instructions for browsing agents
Intelligence on crews stealing ML engineer tokens to mine on GPU clusters

identity_access.summary: A stolen ML engineer token promotes a model and deploys it
The agent uses one identity for every tenant's retrieval and tools

reviewNotes: Advanced: three subtle trusts (logs to training, one agent identity for all tenants, sandboxes sharing nodes with the agent). Present controls that do not apply to a path: the kernel sandbox (egress open), the output guard (tool arguments), the eval gate (prompt and tool changes), the tenant filter (not enforced by the index).
